notes.title: Tap 4 Sex DLC : HOT DATES
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 


We just opened the page for the first DLC for Tap 4 Sex, called "Hot Dates". 
This DLC brings you 2 new dates with Mia and Sophy, 10 new anims, and 15 new images. 


You can add the DLC to your wishlist now, and it will be released on 10th of July. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3783140/Tap_4_Sex__Hot_Dates/
